summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in diezyclutch-baileys@8.6.94
details: No static or traced findings indicate credential theft, install-time code fetching, silent relay to attacker-controlled destinations, backdoor channels, or self-propagation in this package version. The package name resembles the WhatsApp-protocol library family (Baileys), which is a common area for forks and derivatives; name resemblance alone is not evidence of malicious behavior and no payload corroborating a lookalike attack was observed in the inspected files.
